plugins.name: commit-plugin
plugins.description: A collection of skills for Git commit workflows, including commit message generation following the Conventional Commits format.

plugins.name: secret-scanner
plugins.description: An agent that scans code and configuration files for sensitive information such as API keys, passwords, and personal data that must not be exposed in a public repository.

plugins.name: publish-checker
plugins.description: Agents that check an npm package (npm-publish-checker) or Rust crate (crate-publish-checker) for readiness before publishing, verifying package metadata, the actual set of files that will be published, and common publish mistakes.
